t: Serenity | Guided breathing exercise in one minute

Answer questions about your energy, stress, and sleep, and choose the time of day to get a breathing rhythm and a short duration. Start a guided session with an animated display and timer, then review your session summary with no account.

Start now: set your energy, stress, and sleep along with the time of day, and we'll suggest the closest rhythm and a duration that suits you. This page offers a guided breathing session that runs in your browser, with no registration, account, or internet connection; all you need is one minute and a display tracking the inhale, hold, and exhale rhythm. Start by choosing how you feel, then press play and follow the moving circle: it expands on the inhale, stays steady on the hold, and shrinks on the exhale. You can switch patterns, restart the session, and read a short summary showing the number of rounds and the time you completed. Try more than one pattern to find what relaxes you, and make the session a short break between tasks or before bed. This exercise offers no diagnosis or treatment, just a simple tool for focus and inner calm.
How do I start a session?
Choose your energy, stress, sleep, and time, or press «Suggest a rhythm», then press «Start session» and follow the moving circle until the timer ends.
Do I need an account or an internet connection?
No; the exercise runs right on the page, no registration is required, and your notes aren't saved after you close the page.
Each pattern varies in inhale, hold, and exhale timing; short patterns suit a work break, patterns with a longer exhale help when you're stressed, and you can try more than one pattern.
Yes; the Pause button stops the timer and keeps your place, then you can resume from the Start button or reset with the Restart button.
No; the tool is only for relaxation and self-focus, and is not a medical device or a substitute for professional advice.
